segments.text: So he woke up with a thundercloud parked behind his eyes
Red note on the counter, cold rain on the blinds
A bad dream chewing holes through every little plan
That he filled an old mason jar and laughed like a medicine man
One careful swallow and the ceiling turned gold
The ache in his shoulder packed its suitcase and rolled
The landlord called smiling, the dead phone rang clear
Every lost little answer came walking back near
No silver spoon, no laboratory light
Just a private little miracle in the middle of the night
Raise that jar, let the whole world know
In this make-believe town it makes the hard luck go
For the body, for the mind, for the ghost in the hall
Tony's own bright remedy answers every call
Miracle in the mason jar, miracle on demand
He drains to his future with the cure in his hand
His back quit arguing, his nerves quit biting
A metaphysical leak got a sudden good tightening
The mirror said, brother, you look ten years new
And the moon sent a postcard saying, I believe in you
His love came dancing through the kitchen doorway
Said you finally found the rhythm that can make a bad day sway
They chased by the stove with the radio low
And every lonely lock found a key to know
Raise that jar, let the whole world know
In this make-believe town it makes the hard lot go
For the body, for the mind, for the ghost in the hall
Tony's own bright remedy answers every call
Miracle in a mason jar, miracle on demand
He drinks to his future with a cure in his hands
And far beyond the window where the headlines crowd and sting
He dreams of Palestine, peace with children safe to sing
No grand speech, no bottle thrown, no bitter flag unfurled
Just homes rebuilt, no bent hands around a quiet world
He lifts the jar toward morning, toward every broken place
A strange, small, holy answer with a stubborn little grace
Raise that char, let the whole world know
In this wild fictional world, it makes the hard luck go
Spirit, flesh, and memory fall
For questions without end
So when he's on miraculous, cure comes through again, my friend
Miracle in the mason jar, shining warm and clear
The last dark thought dissolves away, the daylight settles near
He sets the jar beside the dawn, his trouble's all undone
Sings I found my private miracle
And holds the final note who tells the note until the song is done
